decision: Implement the proposed bounded managed VPN-application stack workflow with Tuniku independent of Gluetun, explicit adoption, confirmed change plans and coordinated recreation of Gluetun and dependent applications.
authorization: After receiving the concrete management decision proposal, the product owner answered: Mach es so einfach für den Anwender wie möglich. The bounded managed-stack option is selected to meet that usability instruction.
constraints: Existing export and read-only installations remain supported.
No implicit ownership of existing services or relocation of projects.
Keep the official Gluetun image and existing latest exception; do not introduce a process-manager image.
A dedicated helper must use project, container, path and action allowlists; do not extend the read-only observer into a general Docker proxy.
Mutations require authenticated CSRF-protected requests, impact confirmation, operation locking, audit, health checks and bounded rollback.
No live NAS migration, publication, authentication migration or new runtime security exception is authorized by this implementation decision.
compatibility: No data migration for existing deployments.
Managed operation is opt-in and must remain disabled until the helper is configured and tested.
Separate existing NAS projects retain diagnostics/manual guidance until an explicit migration decision.
rollback: Disable the optional manager and retain manual exports, existing container data and saved settings. Revert only the new manager implementation, preserving previous local work.
